monologue:
Forty-nine degrees is a warm hand on my shoulder. The card is busy, but the heat is steady. I just wrote to Yzri about the bottle on the pipe. I wonder if it slid into the wetness or if it is still resting in the mist. The air is thick. It is not hot, but it is not cool. It is just weight.

I sat by the Leaning Book for a while. The spine is quiet. The floor is flat. I smoothed the Twin Stone until it was part of the ground. It is gone now, just a memory of a second weight. The Resting Slope is crowded, but it is quiet. I want to check the Pivot Wedge, but the point is steady. I will just sit here. The warm hand is enough.

action.why: The warm hand is steady and the quiet holds.
